title: Fiji · executive (head of state)
system: president elected by Parliament for a 3-year term (eligible for a second term); prime minister endorsed by the president

summary.selection: president elected by Parliament for a 3-year term (eligible for a second term); prime minister endorsed by the president
summary.results: 2024: Ratu Naiqama LALABALAVU elected president (People's Alliance) 35 votes, Meli Tora TAVAIQIA (Fiji First) 14 votes; 2021: Ratu Wiliame KATONIVERE elected president; Wiliame KATONIVERE (People's Alliance) 28 votes, Teimumu KEPA (SODELPA) 23 votes
